notes: 0x7B0250-0x7B2020 are uPlayer nested-component methods (cPeripheral, cInterface, cLegIkCtrl, cWeaponCtrl, cSECtrl, cProcSpdCtrl, cHitSlowCtrl), not Dante code. Many earlier invented names were wrong and are replaced (was: kept in comments): updateLegLandEfct->cWeaponCtrl::updateEx (P1 renamed the real one at 0x7ABA20 back to uPlayer::updateLegLandEfct), uPlayerNero::setDevilTriggerSe->cSECtrl::setResource, fireEbonyIvoryShot->setGunEffect, fireCoyoteAceShot->setCaGunEffect, fireNunchakuShot->setCaGunNunchakuEffect, setPandoraLauncher*->setGunPandra*, addStyleGauge->addPandoraGauge, checkGilgameshHitTiming->isAtckValDouble, getGroundMaterialFlag->getMtrlFlg. cSECtrl::request/stop (0x7B1FC0/0x7B1FF0/0x7B2020) take the owning uPlayer* in eax and index +0x1D60 (mSeCtrl at uPlayer+0x1D40), so the this-adjust is folded into the callee. ICF folds: 0x7B5020 sync (also uPlayer vtable slot 8), 0x7B7B20 atckGunPoseShotSub (Dante+Nero), 0x7B2570 kMdlHead ctor (Dante+Nero; SE also folds under uPlayerLady), 0x7BDE30 updateMotionSeWeatherCtrl (also Nero slot 117). DX9-only virtuals: slot 123 (0x7B6A20; setDrawMode moved to SE slot 52) and slot 132 (0x7B8D90 stinger-jump check; SE slot 203 is an ICF stub everywhere). SE-only Dante methods absent from DX9: initModel, resetChargeStatus, resetRoundTripEffect, setGilgameshPartsEx00, setGunEiHoneyShotWaitMotion, releaseMajinResource, init/releaseDante/MajinResource, initModel_Normal, getInvincibleMtrlNum, isTwoSometimeStart, isRvBlur, checkGaurdRelease, getReleaseAtckValue (inlined or new). Eight undefined code stubs were defined as functions: 0x7B08D0, 0x7B0E20, 0x7B1360, 0x7B2540, 0x7BF700, 0x7BF7A0, 0x7BF980, 0x7BFB70.
